text: The nominal platform level is +15.00 m. The Owner platform is accepted within +/- 0.15 m (DP-EPCE-0008). Finished floor levels and road levels shall be set on the as-surveyed platform with local trimming only; structural fill needed below +14.85 m is not Contractor scope of cost (paid by the Owner at the Price Schedule unit rate against a joint survey) as agreed in TQ-039 and DEC-OWNR-0002. The south edge strip (N 0 to 25 m) and the old warehouse foundations shall be resurveyed jointly before setting out.
